L3_invariance_check_under_NULL_A.note: NULL-A randomises only marker labels, reading order and title assignment; none is an argument of the L3 statistic.

L2_length_confound_diagnostic.reading: If rank_corr is near 0 on the canonical corpus but large under NULL-B, the reallocation null has manufactured a size-driven geometry that the L2 statistic is sensitive to, and NULL-B is not a valid null for L2.
